blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following statements best describes the insertion sort algorithm?
Tap an option below to answer:
It repeatedly swaps adjacent elements if they are in the wrong order.
This is the description of the Bubble Sort algorithm.
This is the description of the Bubble Sort algorithm.
It repeatedly picks the smallest element from the unsorted portion and places it in its correct sorted position.
This is the description of the Selection Sort algorithm.
This is the description of the Selection Sort algorithm.
It divides the list into a sorted and an unsorted sublist. It then repeatedly takes the first element from the unsorted portion and inserts it into its correct position within the sorted portion.
This accurately describes the Insertion Sort algorithm.
This accurately describes the Insertion Sort algorithm.
One of the above options is correct.
One of the above options is correct.
